languageModel.name: qwen3.5:9b
languageModel.argument: The sentence uses the conjunction 'and' to join two course codes, indicating that both must be completed. According to the CTDL definition of ceterms:alternativeCondition, this represents a context where multiple paths exist but any one path fulfills the parent condition; however, in standard logical parsing for prerequisites, 'and' implies an intersection (all items required), forming an 'all_of' node. The definition of ceterms:requires supports that this is a set of requirements where every item under it is required.

confidence.why: A language model proposed it, and no person has confirmed it.
